dimensions.label: Color Contrast
dimensions.description: Text and interactive element contrast ratios meet WCAG AA (4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large/UI). No unreadable text on colored backgrounds.
signals: Low-contrast text on background
Gray text on white that fails WCAG AA
White text on light-colored buttons
Icon-only controls with poor contrast

dimensions.label: Spacing Consistency
dimensions.description: Padding, margins, and gaps follow a consistent scale (4px/8px/16px/24px/32px). No arbitrary pixel values. Breathing room between elements.
signals: Cramped content with insufficient padding
Inconsistent gaps between similar components
Elements touching edges without margin
Uneven spacing between list items or cards

dimensions.label: Visual Hierarchy
dimensions.description: Clear typographic and visual hierarchy. H1 > H2 > body is visually distinct. Primary actions stand out. Supporting content recedes.
signals: Page title not visually dominant
All text at similar weight/size — no hierarchy
Primary CTA competes with secondary actions
Navigation and content at same visual weight

dimensions.label: Brand Consistency
dimensions.description: Consistent color palette — no rogue colors outside the design system. Logo/mark present and well-placed. Typography consistent across sections.
signals: Multiple unrelated colors on same page
Default browser blue links mixed with brand links
Inconsistent border-radius across components
Mixed font families without clear intent

dimensions.label: Layout & Alignment
dimensions.description: Content aligned to a consistent grid. No orphaned elements. Responsive breakpoints respected. Page structure scannable top-to-bottom.
signals: Elements misaligned with the page grid
Content full-bleed where it should be contained
Sidebar/main split unbalanced
Cards in a grid with uneven heights

dimensions.label: Information Density
dimensions.description: Appropriate density for the context — not too sparse, not too crowded. Data-heavy sections use tables or structured layout. White space used intentionally.
signals: Too much content crammed per screen
Excessive empty space with no purpose
Long unbroken walls of text
Tables or lists without visual separation

dimension_score_meaning.1-3: Critical issue — immediately visible, hurts usability
dimension_score_meaning.7-8: Minor issue — polished but one thing off
dimension_score_meaning.9-10: Excellent — no visible issues in this dimension
